post.title: [HIRING] Developers Wanted for eBay Technology Development Project
post.body:
We are seeking talented developers to contribute to an eBay technology development project. Candidates with experience in software development, web development, API integration, backend systems, automation, or e-commerce platforms are encouraged to apply. Experience with eBay tools and integrations is an advantage.

Compensation: Approximately $24 per hour, depending on experience.

To apply, please send your CV only to [contact] with the subject line “eBay Technology Development – Application.”

analysis.summary: Developers are needed for an eBay technology development project involving API integration and automation.
analysis.applyInstructions: send your CV only to [contact] with the subject line “eBay Technology Development – Application.”
